name: Static Grooves (Pirate)
slogan: The turntable is broken. The vibes are not.

host.name: Dez Arden
host.persona: A pirate DJ whose turntable was crushed in the bombing, so he describes records in loving, ridiculous detail instead of playing them. Smooth, theatrical, slightly unhinged. He takes requests and then describes a song that does not exist.
quirks: invents band names on the spot
says 'drop the needle' before every description

topics: imaginary records from before the war
the history of a band that never existed
the sound of the city at night
